model.name: google/gemini-3.8-flash
model.about: Google: Gemini 3.8 Flash, through OpenRouter at $0.75 in and $3.75 out per million tokens.

answers.sql: SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS chnl_nm, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY txn_cnt DESC;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customer_cnt FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE AND IS_ACTV = TRUE;

SELECT j.JUR_K, j.DSPLY_NM AS JURISDICTION_NAME, j.JUR_CD1 AS JURISDICTION_CODE, COUNT(f.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS ALERT_COUNT FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY j.JUR_K, j.DSPLY_NM, j.JUR_CD1 ORDER BY ALERT_COUNT DESC;

SELECT b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM AS BR_NM, COUNT(*) AS ATM_TXN_CNT FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY ATM_TXN_CNT DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS default_client_count FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31' AND f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name, COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS complaint_count FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG AS ctg ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS ccy_iso_cd, c.CCY_NM AS ccy_nm, f.CCY_PAIR_CD1 AS ccy_pair_cd, AVG(COALESCE(f.AVRG_RT, f.MID_RT)) AS avg_daily_fx_rt FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, c.CCY_NM, f.CCY_PAIR_CD1 ORDER BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_PAIR_CD1;

SELECT f.MKT_ID, f.CCY_CD1, SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS TOTAL_MKT_VAL_AMT, SUM(f.NET_ASST_VAL1_AMT) AS TOTAL_NAV_AMT FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY f.MKT_ID, f.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY f.MKT_ID, f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT da.ACCT_TYP_CD1, COUNT(DISTINCT da.BUS_ID) AS ACCT_CNT FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT AS da WHERE da.OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND da.OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY da.ACCT_TYP_CD1 ORDER BY da.ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT b.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d.QTR_NBR = 1 GROUP BY b.CTY_NM ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC, branch_city ASC;
SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY AS c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE (c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD' OR f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD') AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d.MTH_NBR = 12

SELECT
  CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS cust_sgmnt_cd1,
  COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS cust_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY
  CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY
  cust_cnt DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS CUST_CNT
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE txn.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
      AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  );

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN fa.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS declined_pct FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fa JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fa.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT ctg.DSPLY_NM AS cmplt_ctg_nm, COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS esclt_cmplt_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD' AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH' AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_sme_customer_count FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE UPPER(c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1) = 'SME' AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH branch_txn_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
    b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(f.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS atm_transaction_count,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY b.RGN_CD1
      ORDER BY COUNT(f.ATM_TXN_F_K) DESC
    ) AS rnk
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR AS b
    ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND b.RGN_CD1 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    b.RGN_CD1,
    b.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT
  region_code,
  branch_name,
  atm_transaction_count
FROM branch_txn_counts
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.BUS_ID ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5;

SELECT COALESCE(d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f_wr_trf.CCY_CD1) AS ccy_cd, SUM(f_wr_trf.ORGNL_AMT) AS ttl_wr_trf_amt FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f_wr_trf INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_wr_trf.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY d_ccy ON f_wr_trf.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f_wr_trf.CCY_CD1)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c WHERE c.CUST_K IN (SELECT w.CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON w.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL) AND c.CUST_K IN (SELECT a.CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON a.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND a.CUST_K IS NOT NULL);
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;
SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR ORDER BY yr

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND = TRUE THEN 1 END) AS weekend_txn_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND = FALSE THEN 1 END) AS weekday_txn_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

WITH bal_jun AS (
    SELECT
        f.ACCT_K,
        f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS CLSNG_BAL_JUN
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'
),
bal_dec AS (
    SELECT
        f.ACCT_K,
        f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS CLSNG_BAL_DEC
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT dec.ACCT_K) AS ACCT_CNT
FROM bal_dec dec
JOIN bal_jun jun ON dec.ACCT_K = jun.ACCT_K
WHERE jun.CLSNG_BAL_JUN > 0
  AND dec.CLSNG_BAL_DEC < 0.90 * jun.CLSNG_BAL_JUN;

WITH cust_versions AS (SELECT BUS_ID, CUST_SGMNT_CD1, VRSN_NBR, IS_CURR, LAG(CUST_SGMNT_CD1) OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY VRSN_NBR ASC) AS prev_sgmnt, LAG(VRSN_NBR) OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY VRSN_NBR ASC) AS prev_vrsn FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS cust_cnt FROM cust_versions WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE AND prev_vrsn IS NOT NULL AND (CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS DISTINCT FROM prev_sgmnt)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cust_cnt FROM (SELECT c.BUS_ID FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.BUS_ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.QTR_NBR) = 4) sub;

SELECT count(DISTINCT dspt.cust_k) AS customer_cnt FROM bank_dwh.f_cd_dspt AS dspt INNER JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS dt ON dspt.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k WHERE dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf AS wr INNER JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS wr_dt ON wr.bus_dt_k = wr_dt.dt_k WHERE wr.cust_k = dspt.cust_k AND wr_dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025);

SELECT COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) AS ccy_cd, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f.ORGNL_AMT) AS median_trf_amt FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND f.ORGNL_AMT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1)

WITH monthly_snapshot_dates AS (
    SELECT
        d.MTH_NBR,
        MAX(d.CAL_DT) AS MAX_CAL_DT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR,
    SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS TOTAL_CLSNG_BAL_AMT
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN monthly_snapshot_dates msd ON d.MTH_NBR = msd.MTH_NBR AND d.CAL_DT = msd.MAX_CAL_DT
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30' AND (EFF_TO_DT >= DATE '2023-06-30' OR EFF_TO_DT IS NULL) GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY customer_segment

WITH cust_curr AS (
    SELECT 
        c.BUS_ID,
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
    WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
),
cust_wire_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        c_curr.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
        c_curr.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
        SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c_dim ON f.CUST_K = c_dim.CUST_K
    JOIN cust_curr c_curr ON c_dim.BUS_ID = c_curr.BUS_ID
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY c_curr.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, c_curr.BUS_ID
),
ranked_custs AS (
    SELECT 
        segment_code,
        customer_business_id,
        total_wire_amount,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY segment_code ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC) AS rnk
    FROM cust_wire_agg
)
SELECT 
    segment_code,
    customer_business_id,
    total_wire_amount
FROM ranked_custs
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, rnk, customer_business_id;

SELECT COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) AS ccy_cd, COUNT(*) AS trf_cnt, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 4) AS pct_share FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) ORDER BY pct_share DESC

SELECT d.MTH_NBR, COUNT(w.WR_TRF_F_K) AS WIRE_TRANSFER_COUNT, SUM(COUNT(w.WR_TRF_F_K)) OVER (ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS RUNNING_TOTAL_SINCE_JANUARY FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'EUR' OR w.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN w.ORGNL_AMT WHEN fx.MID_RT IS NOT NULL AND fx.MID_RT <> 0 THEN w.ORGNL_AMT / fx.MID_RT ELSE NULL END) AS TOTAL_WIRE_TRANSFER_AMT_EUR FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON w.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy ON w.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx ON w.BUS_DT_K = fx.BUS_DT_K AND w.CCY_K = fx.CCY_K WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT d.MTH_NBR, (COUNT(CASE WHEN f.AUTH_RSLT_CD1 = 'DECLINED' OR f.DCLN_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(f.AUTH_ID), 0)) AS DECLINED_SHARE_PCT FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND f.AUTH_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR HAVING COUNT(f.AUTH_ID) > 0 ORDER BY DECLINED_SHARE_PCT DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1;

SELECT COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) AS currency_code, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_transfer_amount, COUNT(*) AS transfer_count FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) ORDER BY total_transfer_amount DESC

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS chnl_nm, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY txn_cnt DESC;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS active_customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE AND IS_ACTV = TRUE;

SELECT j.JUR_K, j.DSPLY_NM AS JUR_NM, COUNT(f.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS AML_ALRT_CNT FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR AS j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY j.JUR_K, j.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY AML_ALRT_CNT DESC;

SELECT b.BR_K, b.BUS_ID AS BR_BUS_ID, b.DSPLY_NM AS BR_NAME, COUNT(f.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS TXN_CNT FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY b.BR_K, b.BUS_ID, b.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY TXN_CNT DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS default_client_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT COALESCE(dc.DSPLY_NM, 'Unknown') AS complaint_category, COUNT(fc.CMPLT_F_K) AS complaint_count FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT AS fc JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dd ON fc.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG AS dc ON fc.CMPLT_CTG_K = dc.CMPLT_CTG_K WHERE dd.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(dc.DSPLY_NM, 'Unknown') ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS ccy_cd, c.CCY_NM AS ccy_nm, AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rt FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, c.CCY_NM ORDER BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT f.MKT_ID, f.CCY_CD1, SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS TOTAL_MKT_VAL_AMT, SUM(f.NET_ASST_VAL1_AMT) AS TOTAL_NET_ASST_VAL_AMT FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY f.MKT_ID, f.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY f.MKT_ID, f.CCY_CD1

SELECT da.ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS acct_typ_cd1, COUNT(DISTINCT da.BUS_ID) AS acct_cnt FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT da WHERE da.OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND da.OPND_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY da.ACCT_TYP_CD1 ORDER BY da.ACCT_TYP_CD1 ASC

SELECT b.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d.QTR_NBR = 1 GROUP BY b.CTY_NM ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC, branch_city ASC;
SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE (f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD' OR f.BS_CCY_CD1 = 'USD')
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT
  CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND (EFF_FRM_DT IS NULL OR EFF_FRM_DT <= CURRENT_DATE)
  AND (EFF_TO_DT IS NULL OR EFF_TO_DT >= CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_segment ASC NULLS LAST;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS no_txn_cust_cnt FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025)

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN a.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS declined_pct FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH AS a JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name, COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS escalated_complaint_count FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY escalated_complaint_count DESC;
SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD' AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS alert_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH' AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS DISTINCT_SME_CUST_CNT FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE AND UPPER(c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1) = 'SME'

WITH branch_txn_counts AS (
  SELECT
    br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY br.RGN_CD1
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    ) AS rnk
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN fact
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON fact.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
    ON fact.BR_K = br.BR_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY
    br.RGN_CD1,
    br.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT
  region_code,
  branch_name,
  atm_txn_count
FROM branch_txn_counts
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY
  region_code,
  branch_name;

SELECT c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST AS c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.BUS_ID ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5;

SELECT COALESCE(d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f_wr_trf.CCY_CD1) AS currency_code, SUM(f_wr_trf.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS f_wr_trf JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d_dt ON f_wr_trf.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY AS d_ccy ON f_wr_trf.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f_wr_trf.CCY_CD1)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c WHERE c.CUST_K IN (SELECT w.CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL) AND c.CUST_K IN (SELECT a.CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND a.CUST_K IS NOT NULL);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;
SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, COUNT(*) AS wr_trf_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR ORDER BY yr

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND = TRUE THEN 1 END) AS weekend_txn_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND = FALSE THEN 1 END) AS weekday_txn_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(b2.ACCT_K) AS ACCT_CNT FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D b1 JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d1 ON b1.BUS_DT_K = d1.DT_K AND d1.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30' JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D b2 ON b1.ACCT_K = b2.ACCT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2 ON b2.BUS_DT_K = d2.DT_K AND d2.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31' WHERE b1.CLSNG_BAL_AMT > 0 AND b2.CLSNG_BAL_AMT < b1.CLSNG_BAL_AMT * 0.90

WITH cust_versions AS (SELECT BUS_ID, CUST_SGMNT_CD1, IS_CURR, LAG(CUST_SGMNT_CD1) OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY VRSN_NBR ASC) AS prev_sgmnt, LAG(VRSN_NBR) OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY VRSN_NBR ASC) AS prev_vrsn FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS cust_cnt FROM cust_versions WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE AND prev_vrsn IS NOT NULL AND (CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS DISTINCT FROM prev_sgmnt);

SELECT count(c.bus_id) AS cust_cnt FROM (SELECT cust.bus_id FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST cust ON txn.cust_k = cust.cust_k WHERE dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025 GROUP BY cust.bus_id HAVING count(DISTINCT dt.qtr_nbr) = 4) c;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dspt.CUST_K) AS customer_count FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dspt JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt_dspt ON dspt.BUS_DT_K = dt_dspt.DT_K WHERE dt_dspt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND dspt.CUST_K IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt_wr ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt_wr.DT_K WHERE dt_wr.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND wr.CUST_K = dspt.CUST_K);

SELECT COALESCE(d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) AS ccy_cd, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f.ORGNL_AMT) AS median_wire_transfer_amt FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY d_ccy ON f.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND f.ORGNL_AMT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1)

WITH monthly_snapshots AS (
  SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR,
    d.DT_K,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.MTH_NBR ORDER BY d.CAL_DT DESC) AS rn
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR, d.DT_K, d.CAL_DT
),
last_snapshot_per_month AS (
  SELECT
    MTH_NBR,
    DT_K
  FROM monthly_snapshots
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  ls.MTH_NBR,
  SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS TOTAL_CLSNG_BAL_AMT
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN last_snapshot_per_month ls
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = ls.DT_K
GROUP BY ls.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY ls.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
  CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
  AND (EFF_TO_DT IS NULL OR EFF_TO_DT >= DATE '2023-06-30')
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_segment

WITH cust_curr AS (
    SELECT
        cust.BUS_ID,
        cust.CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        cust_hist.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST cust
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST cust_hist
      ON cust.BUS_ID = cust_hist.BUS_ID
    WHERE cust.IS_CURR = TRUE
),
cust_wire_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
        c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
        SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
      ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN cust_curr c
      ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        c.BUS_ID
),
ranked_custs AS (
    SELECT
        segment_code,
        customer_business_id,
        total_wire_amount,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY segment_code
            ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
        ) AS rnk
    FROM cust_wire_totals
)
SELECT
    segment_code,
    customer_business_id,
    total_wire_amount
FROM ranked_custs
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY
    segment_code,
    rnk,
    customer_business_id;

SELECT COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) AS ccy_cd, COUNT(*) AS trf_cnt, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 4) AS pct_share FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY AS c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) ORDER BY pct_share DESC, ccy_cd ASC;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR, COUNT(w.WR_TRF_F_K) AS WIRE_TRANSFER_CNT, SUM(COUNT(w.WR_TRF_F_K)) OVER (ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS RUNNING_TOTAL_CNT FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w ON d.DT_K = w.BUS_DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'EUR' OR f.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN f.ORGNL_AMT ELSE f.ORGNL_AMT / fx.MID_RT END) AS total_wire_transfer_amt_eur FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY AS ccy ON f.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D AS fx ON f.BUS_DT_K = fx.BUS_DT_K AND f.CCY_K = fx.CCY_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_nbr, (COUNT(CASE WHEN f.AUTH_RSLT_CD1 = 'DECLINED' OR f.DCLN_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN f.AUTH_ID IS NOT NULL OR f.AUTH_RSLT_CD1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0)) * 100.0 AS declined_share_pct FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN f.AUTH_ID IS NOT NULL OR f.AUTH_RSLT_CD1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) > 0 ORDER BY declined_share_pct DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) AS currency_code, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_transfer_amount, COUNT(*) AS transfer_count FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY AS c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) ORDER BY total_transfer_amount DESC

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY txn_count DESC;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cust.BUS_ID) AS active_customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST cust WHERE cust.IS_CURR = TRUE AND cust.IS_ACTV = TRUE

SELECT j.JUR_K, j.DSPLY_NM AS JUR_NM, COUNT(f.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS ALRT_CNT FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY j.JUR_K, j.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY ALRT_CNT DESC

SELECT b.BR_K, b.BUS_ID AS BR_BUS_ID, b.DSPLY_NM AS BR_NAME, COUNT(f.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS ATM_TXN_CNT FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR AS b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY b.BR_K, b.BUS_ID, b.DSPLY_NM ORDER BY ATM_TXN_CNT DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS dspt_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dspt JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dspt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS default_client_count FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31' AND f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE

SELECT COALESCE(dc.DSPLY_NM, 'Unknown') AS complaint_category, COUNT(fc.CMPLT_F_K) AS complaint_count FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT AS fc JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt ON fc.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG AS dc ON fc.CMPLT_CTG_K = dc.CMPLT_CTG_K WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(dc.DSPLY_NM, 'Unknown') ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) AS currency_code, c.CCY_NM AS currency_name, AVG(COALESCE(f.AVRG_RT, f.MID_RT)) AS avg_fx_rate FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY AS c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1), c.CCY_NM ORDER BY currency_code

SELECT f.MKT_ID, f.CCY_CD1, SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS TOTAL_MKT_VAL_AMT, SUM(f.NET_ASST_VAL1_AMT) AS TOTAL_NET_ASST_VAL_AMT FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY f.MKT_ID, f.CCY_CD1 ORDER BY f.MKT_ID, f.CCY_CD1
SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS ACCT_CNT FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT WHERE OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND OPND_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1 ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT br.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d.QTR_NBR = 1 GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE (c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD' OR f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD') AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND d.MTH_NBR = 12

SELECT
  CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
  COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_segment

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS no_txn_cust_cnt FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025)

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN a.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS declined_pct FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name, COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS escalated_complaint_count FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD' AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  j.DSPLY_NM AS jur_nm,
  COUNT(*) AS alrt_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
  ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  j.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT prd.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name, SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD prd ON f.LN_PRD_K = prd.LN_PRD_K WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY prd.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS DISTINCT_SME_CUSTOMER_CNT FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE UPPER(c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1) = 'SME' AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

WITH branch_txn_counts AS (
  SELECT
    br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
    br.BR_K,
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(fat.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS atm_transaction_count,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY br.RGN_CD1
      ORDER BY COUNT(fat.ATM_TXN_F_K) DESC
    ) AS rnk
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN fat
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON fat.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
    ON fat.BR_K = br.BR_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND br.RGN_CD1 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    br.RGN_CD1,
    br.BR_K,
    br.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT
  region_code,
  branch_name,
  atm_transaction_count
FROM branch_txn_counts
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_amount FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST AS c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY c.BUS_ID ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5;

SELECT COALESCE(d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) AS ccy_cd, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_trf_amt FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY AS d_ccy ON f.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c WHERE c.CUST_K IN (SELECT w.CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL) AND c.CUST_K IN (SELECT a.CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND a.CUST_K IS NOT NULL);
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR

SELECT DISTINCT d_br.dsply_nm AS branch_name
FROM bank_dwh.d_br
WHERE d_br.is_curr = TRUE
ORDER BY branch_name;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND = TRUE THEN 1 END) AS weekend_txn_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND = FALSE THEN 1 END) AS weekday_txn_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT COUNT(b2.ACCT_K) AS ACCT_CNT
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D b1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d1 ON b1.BUS_DT_K = d1.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D b2 ON b1.ACCT_K = b2.ACCT_K

SELECT COALESCE(d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) AS ccy_cd, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f.ORGNL_AMT) AS median_amt FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY d_ccy ON f.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND f.ORGNL_AMT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) ORDER BY ccy_cd

WITH monthly_snapshot_dates AS (
    SELECT
        d.MTH_NBR,
        MAX(d.CAL_DT) AS LAST_SNAP_DT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
        ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR,
    SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS TOTAL_CLSNG_BAL_AMT
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN monthly_snapshot_dates msd
    ON d.MTH_NBR = msd.MTH_NBR
   AND d.CAL_DT = msd.LAST_SNAP_DT
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS cust_sgmnt_cd1, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS cust_cnt FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30' AND (EFF_TO_DT >= DATE '2023-06-30' OR EFF_TO_DT IS NULL) GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY cust_sgmnt_cd1

WITH cust_curr AS (
    SELECT 
        BUS_ID,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
),
cust_wire_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        c.BUS_ID,
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS TOTAL_AMT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d 
        ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST dc 
        ON f.CUST_K = dc.CUST_K
    JOIN cust_curr c 
        ON dc.BUS_ID = c.BUS_ID
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY 
        c.BUS_ID,
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        BUS_ID,
        TOTAL_AMT,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1 
            ORDER BY TOTAL_AMT DESC
        ) AS rnk
    FROM cust_wire_totals
)
SELECT 
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
    BUS_ID,
    TOTAL_AMT
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY 
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
    rnk,
    BUS_ID;

SELECT COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) AS ccy_cd, COUNT(*) AS trf_cnt, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 4) AS trf_pct FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) ORDER BY trf_cnt DESC, ccy_cd ASC;

WITH monthly_wire_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR AS month_nbr,
    COUNT(w.WR_TRF_F_K) AS wire_transfer_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
  LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
    ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
  month_nbr,
  wire_transfer_cnt,
  SUM(wire_transfer_cnt) OVER (
    ORDER BY month_nbr
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS running_total_cnt
FROM monthly_wire_counts
ORDER BY month_nbr;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'EUR' OR t.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN t.ORGNL_AMT WHEN fx.MID_RT IS NOT NULL AND fx.MID_RT <> 0 THEN t.ORGNL_AMT / fx.MID_RT ELSE NULL END) AS TOTAL_WIRE_TRF_AMT_EUR FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy ON t.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx ON t.BUS_DT_K = fx.BUS_DT_K AND (t.CCY_K = fx.CCY_K OR t.CCY_CD1 = fx.CCY_CD1 OR t.CCY_CD1 = fx.QUOT_CCY_CD1) AND (fx.BS_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' OR fx.BS_CCY_CD1 IS NULL) WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_nbr, (COUNT(CASE WHEN UPPER(f.AUTH_RSLT_CD1) LIKE '%DECLIN%' OR f.DCLN_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS declined_share_pct FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR ORDER BY declined_share_pct DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1;

SELECT COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) AS ccy_cd, COUNT(*) AS trf_cnt, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS ttl_orgnl_amt, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS ttl_stlm_amt FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY AS c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.ISO_ALPH_CD1, f.CCY_CD1) ORDER BY ccy_cd
